entities.name: Leonos II
entities.description: Arbiter of the Sova Column of the Azorius Senate; born Obez Murzeddi.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Ghost whose link to the physical world Leonos anchored.

entities.name: Parhelion
entities.description: Skyship whose fall obliterated the Senate.

entities.name: Augustin IV
entities.description: Guildmaster whose crimes Leonos feared repeating.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: Supreme Judge who agreed to lead the Azorius.

entities.name: Dissension
entities.description: Period when Leonos anchored Kos's ghost.

events.summary: After the Senate was obliterated, Obez Murzeddi became guildmaster and last Grand Arbiter, taking the name Leonos II.
events.quote: he became the guild's guildmaster and last Grand Arbiter, taking the name Leonos II.

events.summary: Leonos II persuaded Isperia to lead the guild as Supreme Judge.
events.quote: His efforts paid off when Isperia agreed to lead the guild as its Supreme Judge.

relations.quote: Leonos II is the arbiter of the Sova Column
